index.html.seo_title: Securing Agents with OpenShell and NemoClaw | NVIDIA DLI
index.html.description: Build and secure AI agents with NemoClaw, OpenClaw, OpenShell, Hermes Agent, and Deep Agents in this free NVIDIA DLI browser course.

01a-loop.html.seo_title: AI Agent Loops: Perception, Reasoning, and Action | NVIDIA DLI
01a-loop.html.description: Build an AI agent loop from observations, state, decisions, actions, and feedback, then inspect the exact context a model receives on each turn.

01b-react.html.seo_title: ReAct Agents: Reasoning, Acting, and Tool Calls | NVIDIA DLI
01b-react.html.description: Implement a ReAct agent that alternates reasoning and acting, handles tool calls, preserves observations, and stops on an explicit finish condition.

01c-tools.html.seo_title: Agent Tools, Function Calling, and MCP | NVIDIA DLI
01c-tools.html.description: Scale an agent from one function to discoverable tools, sub-agents, and MCP while keeping schemas, authority, consent, and trust boundaries explicit.

02a-routing.html.seo_title: Agent Workflows: ReWOO, Routing, and Parallel Work | NVIDIA DLI
02a-routing.html.description: Compare ReAct with plan-first ReWOO workflows, route work to specialists, and control what context crosses sequential and parallel agent boundaries.

02b-rag.html.seo_title: Agentic RAG, Retrieval, and GraphRAG | NVIDIA DLI
02b-rag.html.description: Build the retrieval ladder from generation alone to traditional RAG, agent-controlled retrieval, parent retrieval, multimodal search, and GraphRAG.

02c-deep.html.seo_title: Deep Agents and Deep Research Workflows | NVIDIA DLI
02c-deep.html.description: Build a deep research agent that plans, delegates to fresh-context sub-agents, preserves evidence in shared files, and synthesizes cited results with LangChain deepagents.

03a-kickstart.html.seo_title: Connect NemoClaw: OpenClaw Gateway in OpenShell | NVIDIA DLI
03a-kickstart.html.description: Connect the browser course to a NemoClaw launchable, verify OpenClaw agent metadata and WebSockets, and keep launchable access separate from the gateway token.

03b-openclaw.html.seo_title: OpenClaw Agent Harness in NemoClaw | NVIDIA DLI
03b-openclaw.html.description: Inspect the OpenClaw agent harness inside NemoClaw, including its persistent session, file-backed workspace, agent identity, tools, and OpenShell boundary.

03c-always-on.html.seo_title: Always-On OpenClaw and Hermes Agents | NVIDIA DLI
03c-always-on.html.description: Trace skills, heartbeats, cron jobs, sub-agents, and messaging controls in always-on OpenClaw and Hermes Agent applications before applying OpenShell containment.

04a-safety.html.seo_title: OpenShell Sandboxes for OpenClaw, Hermes, and Deep Agents | NVIDIA DLI
04a-safety.html.description: Test how OpenShell constrains files, networks, processes, and inference around OpenClaw in NemoClaw, and how the same boundary can contain Hermes or LangChain deepagents.

04b-modern-clis.html.seo_title: Modern CLI Agents: OpenClaw, Hermes, Codex, and Claude Code | NVIDIA DLI
04b-modern-clis.html.description: Compare the tools, persistence, unattended execution, and security defaults of OpenClaw, Hermes Agent, Codex CLI, Claude Code, Cursor, and their OpenShell boundary.

04c-going-further.html.seo_title: Deploying NemoClaw, OpenShell, and Deep Agents | NVIDIA DLI
04c-going-further.html.description: Plan deployment and continued learning across NemoClaw, OpenShell, OpenClaw, Hermes Agent, and LangChain Deep Agents with current requirements and public references.
